title: By 6 months, most babies take turns making sounds with a person
summary: The CDC 6-month language list says most babies take turns making sounds with you.
body: The CDC 6-month page lists, under language and communication, taking turns making sounds with you. The turn is sound for sound. It is not yet a sentence and not the later two-word phrase. A tip on the same page suggests copying the baby's sounds during back-and-forth play, which is a caregiver activity, not the milestone itself. The milestone is what most babies do by 6 months on the United States list.

sources.title: Milestones by 6 Months

sources.note: US federal page, public domain. Opened 2026-11-26. Reviewed date on the page is 16 May 2026. Supports the language milestone 'Takes turns making sounds with you.'
